blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — A new lava dome has been spotted inside the summit crater of Mayon Volcano, prompting warnings of possible renewed volcanic activity, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) said Friday, Nov. 13. The dome was first observed Friday morning through a close-up camera monitoring system at the Mayon Volcano Observatory. “Lava domes typically occur at the onset of eruptive unrest at Mayon. But if anything, the 2026 eruption has not been typical. We need to prepare for renewed activity,” Antonia V.
